name: Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy
description: Provides a hierarchical structure for Entity Reference fields, allowing entities to be organized in a rooted tree.
project_description: Entity Reference (with) Hierarchy extends Drupal core's entity_reference field into a rooted tree stored on a single multi-value field. Rather than chaining separate parent-reference fields across entities (the nested-set model used by e.g. Entity Hierarchy), it stores a tiny 'depth' integer alongside each reference item's target_id, and derives the parent/child structure from the field's delta ordering combined with that depth. The multi-value edit form is rendered as a drag-and-drop tabledrag tree (the same UI pattern as core taxonomy terms and menu links), with a custom 'all' tabledrag relationship allowing rows to be re-parented and re-ordered together. Two 'with hierarchy' formatters (Rendered entity, Label) render the referenced entities as nested ol/ul lists following the outline. A field_formatter_info_alter hook also makes every standard entity_reference formatter selectable on the hierarchy field type. Three submodules extend the ecosystem: entity_reference_hierarchy_revisions adds a revision-aware field type/widget/formatter on top of Entity Reference Revisions; entity_reference_hierarchy_ief adds an Inline Entity Form complex widget with the depth column; and entity_reference_hierarchy_paragraphs adds a Paragraphs Classic widget so nested paragraph layouts can be built on the hierarchy field. The whole hierarchy is data on the host entity, so ancestors, descendants and sibling order are computable in-memory via getFieldHierarchyOutline().
